# `aitbc energy operator verify`

Verify an energy quote's operator signature and freshness.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc energy operator verify [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--quote-file` | path | — | yes | JSON file containing an energy quote |
| `--check-oracle` | flag | `false` | no | Also verify against the on-chain IEnergyPricing oracle |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc energy operator verify --quote-file <quote_file>
```
